SIDDHI PARKHI

+91- 8554879260

parkhi.siddhi521@gmail.com

Investment Banking| Financial Operations|



JOB OBJECTIVE

PROFILE SUMMARY

Dynamic finance professional with a robust foundation in financial analysis, seeking to leverage expertise in the banking and financial services industry to drive growth and enhance operational efficiency.

Results-driven Finance & Investment Banking Operations Professional with over 8 years of experience in Cash management, Bank reconciliation, Investor Accounting, and Regulatory reporting, EFT Payments. I ensured seamless fund settlements and high operational accuracy in fast-paced global banking environments.



Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end cash flow management, including intraday uploads, overdraft analysis, cash reconciliation and SWIFT-based transfers, supporting fund managers and liquidity teams with real-time, error-free financial data.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology- Pune University (2012)

Proven ability to mitigate financial and operational risks through root cause analysis, proactive resolution of cash breaks, and process standardization— enhancing efficiency and compliance across multi-stakeholder functions. Skilled in regulatory frameworks and data accuracy controls, including reporting obligations for CFTC, MAS, EMIR, MIFID & SFTR regulations, with a strong track record of timely publications and zero regulatory breaches.



HSC Maharashtra Board (2008)

Adept at leveraging tools like CRIMS 22R1, MS Office, and VISIO to automate reporting workflows, design SOPs, and streamline communication between custody, fund accounting, and front-office teams for optimal cash positioning.

SSC Maharashtra Board (2006)

WORK EXPERIENCE

Feb’26-till present| Lancesoft (Client- Morgan Stanley) Senior Analyst- : Trade and Transactions Reporting Operations

CORE COMPETENCIES

Responsibilities:

Investment Banking Operations Cash & Liquidity Management Reconciliation &Cash Break Resolution Payment Settlement Lifecycle Regulatory Reporting (CFTC , MAS, EMIR, MIFID & SFTR )

SWIFT Payments & Fund Transfers Stakeholder Collaboration Process Optimization & SOP Documentation

Risk & Exception Management Exercise sound judgment and analysis Demonstrate Commitment to Control and Risk Management Communicate Effectively Technical Knowledge & Experience Product Knowledge Team Work

Execute Operations processes and support process management and project efforts. • Centrally coordinate, manage and control this process across vendor and other geographical locations to ensure regulatory reporting exceptions are managed effectively on a daily basis. • Given the ever-changing regulatory landscape; making sure technology priorities are aligned to areas of maximum exposure and Operations are receiving the necessary rule guidance and interpretation from Compliance to support new and existing requirements effectively. • Responsible for the accurate and timely reporting of trade and transactions; highlighting, analyzing and remediating regulatory reporting issues. • Responsible for coordinating across multiple stakeholders such as Technology, Client Relationship Managers, Trade Support Groups (TSG) and Compliance, to undertake the appropriate remediation steps to resolve reporting issues. • Analyse and expose ambiguous or complex issues, identify root causes and propose future actions. • Ensure timely escalation of any issues to Operations Management, Compliance and IT where appropriate. • Take ownership for and follow through to conclusion on any issues or questions submitted by Operations teams seeking guidance from Compliance where required. • Work towards improving efficiency, controls and overall reporting framework. • Demonstrate a detailed knowledge of the processes, projects, systems, markets and instruments that influence their team.

KEY HIGHLIGHTS

Achieved maximum accuracy in cash flow processing and reconciliation by using CRIMS.

Resolved cash breaks and overdrafts through proactive exception management, root cause analysis, and collaboration with cross-functional teams across custody and fund accounting.

Ensured on-time MiFID II trade reporting and maintained zero regulatory breaches, strengthening compliance governance and audit readiness across all reporting cycles.

Worked towards improving efficiency, controls and overall reporting framework Analysed and exposed ambiguous or complex issues, identified root causes and proposed future actions

Apr’17-Aug’25| Atos Syntel Mar’19-Aug’25| Senior Associate- : Investment Banking Cash Operations Analyst

Responsibilities: • Client Order & Transaction Management: Processed cash flows, fees, and expenses with precision in a high-risk, fast-paced environment while meeting tight deadlines. • Cash Transfers & SWIFT, EFT Confirmations: Executed internal and external cash transfers, coordinated with custody, IBOR, and fund accounting teams, provided SWIFT confirmations, and approved processed entries. Executed timely manual EFTs, recurring manual EFTs. Intraday Cash & Overdraft Management: Uploaded same-day settlements, position reconciliation in CRIMS, ensured accurate portfolio visibility for fund managers, identified overdrawn accounts, and performed root cause analysis with corrective actions.



Cash Breaks Resolution & Process Optimization: Reconciled discrepancies between assumed and actual settlements, collaborated with custody, middle office, and client managers, and maintained SOPs for accurate residual cash management. Managed FX Payments, intercompany settlements.

Month End Close: Supported month end close activities and reconciliations.

Apr’17-Feb’19| Investment Banking Regulatory Reporting Analyst • Published trade data in line with MiFID II regulations, handling manual publications,

cancellations, and TRADEcho submissions with accuracy and timeliness.

Analyzed trade reports for rejections and over-published trades, resolving issues through proactive follow-ups, team coordination, and SOP maintenance.

TECHNICAL SKILLS CRIMS 22R1 | Microsoft Office | VBA | Microsoft VISIO | CITI Velocity| Unavista
